author: KCodyB
what_it_is: A 100% save file for v1.1 of Mischief Makers.All yellow gems, all S ranks, and maxed out red gems.I saw nobody uploaded a save file with all S-ranks, and decided to do it myself! Use this for whatever wants or needs you may have!
format: 36928 bytes laid out as a DexDrive .n64 but with an all-zero 0x1040-byte header (no magic), then a 32 KiB Controller Pak as savefileconverter.com builds one (its random-serial ID pattern, index-table checksum byte 0): one cart-save note "MISCHIEF MAKERS" ext 1 (3BADD1E5/FADE), 2 pages = the 4 Kbit EEPROM

verified.converted_with: tools/gamefaqs/n64-dexdrive.py convert mischief-makers.33367.n64 OUT: dexdrive-blank-header: pak = the 32768 bytes after the 0x1040-byte header; cart-save note 'MISCHIEF MAKERS' (GameShark 3BADD1E5/FADE): raw EEPROM, 512 bytes

converted_standalone.how: the same bytes as the .srm regions, as standalone Mupen64Plus keeps them: <GoodName (32 chars)>-<MD5 8>.eep/.sra/.fla/.mpk in its save folder

verified.baseline: with no save: Which? shows 1 Start, 2 Start; Start begins the name entry

mupen64plus-next.detail: Which?: file 1 "Marina", F, Age 16, 9999 red gems, 53 yellow gems, 00 day 16 hrs 18 min 10 sec; Start on it opens Imperial HQ with S ranks on every stage

note: Not written by a DexDrive: the pak has savefileconverter.com's random-serial ID pattern and 00 index-table checksum, and the note name is the uploader's file name in capitals, as that tool makes it; the DexDrive header is all zeros. The description says v1.1, so the Rev 1 release.
